title: A.R.S. § 20-321 — Definitions
publication_or_effective_date: 2026 amendments: general effective date 2026-09-12; see B-S05–06
supported_claim: Compensated adjusting includes investigating or negotiating claim settlement; specified exclusions depend on the actual role and conditions.
limitation: An estimator title or contractor license alone does not establish an exclusion; technical assistance exclusion has a specified retaining party and sole-purpose condition.

title: A.R.S. § 20-321.01 — Licensing of adjusters
publication_or_effective_date: Current text accessed 2026-09-21; original effective date not established
supported_claim: A person may not act as or claim to be an adjuster without the required license.
limitation: Read with the definitions and exclusions; an individual license has not been checked for any actual participant.

title: A.R.S. § 20-321.02 — Application of other laws
publication_or_effective_date: 2026 amendments: general effective date 2026-09-12; see B-S05–06
supported_claim: Adjusters face restrictions on solicitation during an ongoing loss/emergency, direct or indirect repair participation on an adjusted claim, and endorsement of payment instruments.
limitation: Does not establish that separate related entities cure indirect participation; application to a particular business arrangement requires review.

title: A.R.S. § 32-1158.02 — Residential construction contracts
publication_or_effective_date: 2026 amendments: general effective date 2026-09-12; see B-S05–06
supported_claim: Special post-storm contract disclosures, cancellation rights, deductible restrictions, limits on adjusting/settlement conduct, and owner-permitted uncompensated communication.
limitation: Subsection A expressly addresses insurer-designated catastrophic storm areas and resident/intended-resident purchasers. Do not assume every monsoon qualifies or that failure of A creates an exemption from all other provisions.

title: Laws 2026, Chapter 157 (SB 1206)
authority: Enacted Arizona session law; official Legislature PDF
locator: §§ 1–3; printed pp. 1–6; approval/file stamps on printed p. 6 (PDF p. 7)
supported_claim: Enacted changes to §§ 20-321, 20-321.02 and 32-1158.02; approved June 19 and filed June 22, 2026.
limitation: Enactment is not the same event as effectiveness. No special effective-date, emergency, or retroactivity clause was found in the seven-page law.

title: Arizona Legislature — General Effective Dates
locator: 2026, Fifty-seventh Legislature, Second Regular Session row
supported_claim: The session general effective date is September 12, 2026.
limitation: A particular law can provide a different date; this table must be paired with the actual enacted law.

title: A.R.S. § 1-244 — Retroactivity of statutes
publication_or_effective_date: Current text accessed 2026-09-21; original effective date not established
locator: Entire section
supported_claim: Arizona statutes are not retroactive unless expressly declared.
limitation: Does not itself resolve application to post-effective-date conduct on an older claim; retain loss, contract, communication, and repair dates.

title: A.R.S. § 20-461 — Unfair claim settlement practices
publication_or_effective_date: Current text accessed 2026-09-21; original effective date not established
supported_claim: Claim-handling standards include reasonable investigation, prompt communications and explanation; subsection A includes a general-business-practice frequency element; subsection D creates an administrative remedy, not a private cause of action.
limitation: An estimate difference or one missed date does not alone prove all elements. This does not eliminate separate contract or common-law claims.

title: A.A.C. R20-6-801 — Unfair Claims Settlement Practices
authority: Arizona administrative rule; official Secretary of State compilation
publication_or_effective_date: Adopted 1982-01-12; latest amendment shown effective 2024-01-07 (corrected effective date); official compilation Supplement 26-1 dated 2026-03-31
locator: R20-6-801(A)–(G), printed pp. 56–58 / PDF pp. 58–60, especially printed p. 57; Historical Note on printed p. 58 / PDF p. 60
supported_claim: Insurer communication/investigation/proof-of-loss response duties with distinct triggers and periods.
limitation: Compilation date is distinct from rule effective dates. Automobile-only subsection H is not a roof-matching rule. Precise holiday computations and any later rule notices remain to be checked before alleging breach.

title: Walker v. Auto-Owners Insurance Co., No. CV-21-0236-CQ
authority: Published Arizona Supreme Court opinion; official court PDF
supported_claim: Labor depreciation was unavailable under the policy at issue; ACV methodology and other-policy outcomes depend on policy terms.
limitation: Do not turn this holding into a blanket ban under every differently worded endorsement; no full citator treatment check completed.

title: Hanson v. Commercial Union Insurance Co., 150 Ariz. 283, 723 P.2d 101 (App. 1986)
authority: Published Arizona Court of Appeals opinion; primary opinion reproduced by Justia
locator: 150 Ariz. at 285–87; 723 P.2d at 103–05; appraisal scope and policy provision
supported_claim: Appraisers act within the submission/policy authority; valuation does not confer general coverage, fee, interest, or offset adjudication authority.
limitation: Older fire-loss case; apply actual clause and submission, not a universal appraisal procedure. No full citator check.

title: Chew v. Homesite Insurance Co., No. CV-25-00818-PHX-JJT, Doc. 19
authority: U.S. District Court, District of Arizona order; official GovInfo copy; persuasive, not controlling state appellate authority
locator: pp. 3–6, especially discussion of causation and itemized appraisal
supported_claim: A roof valuation can be appraised in itemized form while preserving existing coverage disputes; all alleged damage was ordered valued in that case.
limitation: Fact-specific federal trial order; no universal right to that procedure or to replacement; subsequent docket history not checked.

title: City of Phoenix — Building Construction Codes
locator: 2024 City of Phoenix Building Construction Codes; Ordinance G-7397 and implementation links

limitation: Phoenix city only. Parcel jurisdiction, application/permit dates, transition rules, roof-specific code section and enforcement are not supplied.

title: Hanks v. American Family Mutual Insurance Co., No. CV-12-00880-PHX-DGC, Doc. 53
authority: U.S. District Court, District of Arizona order; official GovInfo copy; persuasive
locator: pp. 2–5; matching endorsement, notice and denial of insured summary judgment
supported_claim: Matching and discontinued-tile disputes can turn on an undamaged-property exclusion and notice evidence; the insured did not obtain summary judgment on this record.
limitation: Not a final universal ruling allowing or forbidding matching. Opening paragraph contains an apparent chronology error; rely on court filing/date stamp for the order date.

title: Trudel v. American Family Mutual Insurance Co., No. CV-12-1208-PHX-SMM, Doc. 97
authority: U.S. District Court, District of Arizona order; primary order reproduced by Justia; persuasive
locator: printed pp. 4, 12–14; matching endorsement and disputed notice
supported_claim: Whether the matching endorsement applied and whether reasonable expectations limited it presented fact questions in that case.
limitation: Denial of insurer summary judgment is not an award or a statewide matching entitlement. Official GovInfo candidate failed; inspected reproduced order.
